title: Bitmanip Table 2.2 recovered: the lost permutation-reachability counts
statement: The draft spec's cumulative counts of bit permutations reachable with N instructions -- ROT+GREV: 1, 62, 864, 4640, 23312, 92192, 294992, 703744, 1012856, 1046224, 1048576; ROT+GREV+SHFL: 1, 85, 3030, 78659, 2002167 -- are reproduced exactly. The spec cites its source as svn.clairexen.net/handicraft/2019/permexplore, which returns 404.
scope: XLEN=32; depth 10 for ROT+GREV, depth 4 for ROT+GREV+SHFL

evidence.note: Universal claims like this need a closure-transcript certificate, not per-instance DRAT (see OP.format.closure-transcript).
